Name one common source of oil contamination in aviation systems.

summary_questions: Explain the difference between high-grade and standard lubricating oils based on their nomenclature.
Describe two major consequences of oil contamination on aircraft engine operation.
How does the nomenclature system help in selecting the correct oil for specific engine types?
